cost: Slice construction/folds/cumulative/find/diff cost O(N+S), where N=numel and S=number of slices; shaped empties can have N=0,S>0. Sort/median cost O(N log(max(L,2))+S), unique O(N log(max(N,2))). Slices retain O(N+S) indices/vector headers; outputs and sorting copies also include S overhead. Repeated diff O(order*(N+S)), with order0 clone passthrough.
description: Slice geometry maps dim1 to columns, dim2 to rows, greater dims to singleton cells. sum/prod fold complex values with identities0/1; mean divides by slice length. cumulative and executed nonempty differences, plus several statistics, use real data only. diff order0 returns the original cloned matrix; diff1 zero-length differentiated dimension also clones. minmax selects first strict improving magnitude/real key; sort emits stable slice positions; find emits 1-based column-major indices; unique sorts real values and maps original positions.
